feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: NVIDIA REINSTATES HUANG
entry.summary: Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO.

entry.title: From Wall Street to Main Street, how artificial intelligence is affecting the economy
entry.summary: Artificial intelligence is sending shock waves through the stock market, as investors try to predict how their big bets will pay off. Meanwhile some real businesses are putting AI to work, with mixed results.

entry.title: Chief economist for Moody's Analytics on why Anthropic's IPO caused market volatility
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with Mark Zandi, chief economist for Moody's Analytics, about Anthropic's Wall Street debut and why it seems to have triggered recent market volatility.

entry.title: Thanksgiving storms threaten travel on both coasts
entry.summary: Both coasts are going to be battered by Thanksgiving storms, just as millions travel to share the holiday with family and friends. Expect the weather to delay flights and make driving difficult.

entry.title: Mushroom supplements promise health benefits. What does the science say?
entry.summary: Wellness influencers say mushroom supplements can help with your gut health, focus and immune system. Here is where research suggests there are some links.

entry.title: K is for kindness, but families worry the world has less of it
entry.summary: A decade after first asking families about kindness, Sesame Workshop asked parents similar questions. They responded that their kids are getting kinder even as the wider world becomes less so.

entry.title: Let's talk turkey: Here's how Thanksgiving meal costs have changed this year
entry.summary: Grocery costs have been on the rise, but food-price analysts say it's unclear if you'll spend more on the Thanksgiving meal this year. Some people are deciding not to host or are hosting fewer guests.

entry.title: Ian Charleson played Hamlet while he was dying. Still, he was 'dazzling'
entry.summary: The new movie Elsinore is about the late Scottish actor's critically-acclaimed performance as Hamlet while he was dying of AIDS. His final role is only part of his powerful story.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: A look at how artificial intelligence is affecting the economy, NATO to meet after Russian missiles hit Poland, negotiators fail to reach a deal as COP31 comes to an end.

entry.title: After midterm losses, Republicans debate what's next for the party
entry.summary: In the wake of their midterm election losses, Republicans are discussing what happened and what the future might be for their party.
